text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka asked me to help her with dance practice.
Her request was—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer...
...Could you please say something?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm still not used to
dancing amidst such lively surroundings.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: During a race, when I'm focused on running, it doesn't bother me too much, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So... I want you to cheer for me
as loud as you possibly can.

And so, I ended up cheering for Silence Suzuka
as she danced, but—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for coming today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I hope you enjoy not just the race,
but the Winning Live as well...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...W-Well then—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I just can't seem to focus after all... What should I do...?
choice_data_list: Let's try to answer what the fans are asking for.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I just can't seem to focus after all... What should I do...?
choice_data_list: Let's try to answer what the fans are asking for.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. There will be way more spectators at the actual event, after all."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for holding things up.
Let us resume.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Um, where was I again?
Moving on to the musicâ

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Over this way...?

Despite struggling, Silence Suzuka danced through to the end
amidst the cheers. She should be fine for the real performance.
I suggested to Silence Suzuka that if she couldn't focus, she might as well just answer.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. This is Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Please make sure to enjoy the concert as well.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Phew.
Did I manage to do it well?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Ah.

Afterward, Silence Suzuka managed to pull off
her dance routine. I'm looking forward to her next live performance.
